newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares end firm, telecom CTC shines.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares end firm, telecom CTC shines.

text.p: Chilean stocks closed firmer for the second day in a row in strong trade with telecom Compania de Telecomunicaciones de Chile (CTC) among the day's top gainers, said traders.
The rally could be short-lived with the bolsa expected to retreat Friday as stocks hit a profit-taking buffer, they said.
The 40-share index ended up 0.99 percent at 116.42 points. The general firmed 0.7 percent to 5,355.59 points amid turnover of 16.6 billion pesos.

CTC soared on foreign demand amid speculation that the buy orders could be from Telefonica de Espana which is keen to boost the stock prices of its Latin American investments before the Spanish firm's imminent privatization, said analysts.
Telefonica owns around 43 percent of CTC, Chile's largest telecom operator.
But CTC could slip Friday on profit-taking if there is no fresh news on the company, said dealers.
Other winners included glass-maker Cristales, up 3.8 percent at 2,948 pesos and forestry firm Masisa, which firmed 3.08 percent at 234 pesos.
Losers included state water utility Emos, down 1.85 percent at 106 pesos, and telecom Conatel, which lost 1.64 percent to 300 pesos.
